items.title: The nearly complete programme for the MängudeÖÖ Conference is now live!
items.body:
Mängude öö team will continue adding more details about the talks. The full workshop schedule and registration will be announced next week.

This is shaping up to be a must attend gathering for game developers from Estonia and neighbouring countries! The conference ticket also gives you access to the MängudeÖÖ game party!

See you at the MängudeÖÖ Conference on October 16 and let’s celebrate video games together at MängudeÖÖ on October 17!
https://lnkd.in/dZtEahAk

items.title: Gamescom is fast approaching
items.body:
And EGDA has a representative going. Feel free to approach our board member Jevgeni Orehhov to chat or just to say hi!

The gamescom 2026 will take place from 26-30 August 2026 in Cologne and we couldn't be more excited to attend.

items.title: Happy end of the week everyone!
items.body:
We've been asked to share a survey to companies operating in the gaming industry in Estonia. It is an export survey regarding companies working in the creative field.

Please fill out the survey here: https://lnkd.in/dYBHdqEY

EIS is accepting replies until the 10th of August.

items.title: TipiLAN GameDev Expo is coming back in 2026!
items.body:
Last year, the TipiLAN expo area was legendary, with 35 local games, amazing educational partners, and the first-ever EGG Awards celebrating unreleased Estonian indie games.

Now we’re calling Estonian game devs again!

If you're working on a game, whether it’s a polished product, a playable demo, a student project, or still a work-in-progress, we’d love to showcase it at TipiLAN 2026.

The expo takes place on 11–12 September at TalTech. Submit your game here (deadline 2 August): https://lnkd.in/ehBpn9hx

Join the server here: https://lnkd.in/ez4nhQjr

Let’s make TipiLAN 2026 another amazing showcase of Estonian game development!
